product.description: Workstream™ by Monoprice™Sit-Stand Single Monitor and Keyboard Desk Mount, Up to 32-Inch, Pneumatic Assist, VESA CompatibleEffortless Height Adjustments for Enhanced Comfort and ProductivityTransform your desk into a healthier, more ergonomic workspace with the Workstream™ by Monoprice™ Sit-Stand Single Monitor and Keyboard Workstation Desk Mount. This height-adjustable workstation provides a smooth transition between sitting and standing, promoting better posture, enhanced productivity, and a healthier work environment. Built for home offices and professional workspaces, it supports single monitors measuring up to 32 inches (maximum weight of 17.6 pounds) and keyboards weighing up to 2.2 pounds.With an effortless gas-spring pneumatic assist, you can raise, lower, tilt, swivel, or pull the monitor and keyboard to the perfect ergonomic position, giving you complete control over your workspace setup. 75x75 and 100x100 VESA® pattern compatibility allows this sit-stand workstation to fit a wide range of monitors, while the ±35° tilt and ±90° swivel ensure an ideal viewing angle. Crafted from high-grade aluminum and steel, this adjustable workstation is as durable as it is functional.This sit-stand desk mount includes cable management clips to keep your desk neat and clutter-free, with the flexibility of clamp or grommet mounting for quick and easy installation.
